# proxmox_cluster_firewall_ip_set_entry (Resource)

Manages an address, network, or alias entry in a cluster firewall IP set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_cluster_firewall_ip_set" "trusted" {
  name = "trusted"
}

resource "proxmox_cluster_firewall_ip_set_entry" "management" {
  ip_set  = proxmox_cluster_firewall_ip_set.trusted.name
  cidr    = "10.10.0.0/24"
  comment = "Management network"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) IPv4/IPv6 address, CIDR network, or alias. Changes require replacement.
- `ip_set` (String) Parent cluster firewall IP set name. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Entry comment.
- `nomatch` (Boolean) Exclude this entry from the IP set match.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in `ip_set/cidr` form.
